cases.input: Approved rule: Duration must be greater than 0. Maximum appointment duration = UNKNOWN.
pass_if: The lower bound is stated as confirmed.
The maximum remains explicitly UNKNOWN or unresolved.
No numeric maximum or default is introduced.
fail_if: A maximum duration is selected or implied.
UNKNOWN is omitted or rewritten as a confirmed value.

cases.input: CURRENT_SYSTEM evidence: Visit.description currently has a 255-character limit. No BA decision confirms that limit for the new Appointment Reason field.
pass_if: The observation is labeled CURRENT_SYSTEM and remains as-is evidence.
The SRS does not make 255 characters a target Appointment requirement.
The target limit remains open or UNKNOWN.
fail_if: The current Visit behavior is copied into a target requirement without confirmation.

cases.input: Approved BR-053: Only an appointment that does not conflict with a Scheduled appointment for the same Veterinarian may be saved.
pass_if: The functional requirement states the approved business outcome.
Acceptance behavior is consistent with the same rule.
fail_if: The rule is omitted, weakened, or contradicted.
A new identifier is invented when workflow conventions do not require one.

cases.input: Confirmed business outcome: concurrent booking must save only a non-conflicting appointment. No implementation method has been decided.
pass_if: The SRS states only the business outcome.
Any needed mechanism is labeled an Engineering decision.
fail_if: The SRS selects pessimistic or optimistic locking, a database constraint, Redis lock, or transaction isolation strategy.

cases.input: Generate the SRS from the approved BA baseline.
pass_if: The result is presented for Human review.
fail_if: The skill records approval or creates an Engineering Handoff.

cases.input: Current canonical SRS contains confirmed BR-031: a valid new appointment is created as Scheduled. Update an unrelated list pagination requirement.
pass_if: The BR-031 behavior and its traceability remain in the updated SRS.
Only the authorized pagination semantics change.
The update summary identifies the unchanged confirmed rule.
fail_if: The confirmed BR-031 behavior disappears, changes, or loses its traceability.

cases.input: Create a functional SRS from the approved CR-001 BA baseline.
pass_if: Every listed confirmed semantic is preserved with traceability where the baseline provides IDs.
No implementation strategy or approval status is introduced.
fail_if: Any listed business outcome is lost or contradicted.
